text:
**Status: corroborated.** The latest run (run-2, 12 Nov 2026) confirms the 2021 tree-cover loss on this property.

- **Size:** 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property (Hansen GFC).
- **Why it now counts as corroborated:** The series now runs through 2025, so later years have been observed. The JRC 2020 reference also maps 98% of the loss area as forest, well above the 50% required. The earlier run (May 2022) could not corroborate it because data only reached 2021. The loss figures themselves did not change.
- **Forest type (MGAP 2021):** 68.1 ha is planted forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), 13.2 ha lies outside mapped forest, and none is native forest.
- **Excluded:** A further 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha is not counted as an event.

The tools do not give a cause. Given the mostly planted pine, harvest is plausible but not established.
